motivation: The old H1-H11 strategy results were produced under materially different conditions, including the legacy alternating-lock arena and mostly 10k-node search.
The current stack uses Tetrp synchronous authority, corrected placement transport and garbage timing, H12-corrected DAG behavior, and a 200k-node review budget.
Therefore old H1-H11 results are treated as historical priors and hypothesis-generation evidence, not as current promotion or rejection verdicts.

fixed_current_stack.observation_boundary: own board/current/hold/exactly Next5/combo/B2B-Surge/observable pending garbage and own timing history only
fixed_current_stack.h13_product_note: Keep H13 correctness support for persistent interactive bot paths; do not use snapshot KO tests to judge H13 strength.
fixed_current_stack.compute_policy: H14 evidence is retained only as the basis for the provisional 200k product/search budget.

baseline_and_benchmark.benchmark_role: Reference checkpoint only. It is not the automatic promotion opponent.

old_hypothesis_policy.H1_to_H11: Re-screen under the current stack. Old good/bad labels do not carry forward as verdicts.
old_results_use: Prioritize which hypothesis families to test first.
Narrow sensible parameter ranges and avoid repeating obviously unproductive regions.
Identify plausible interactions and context-dependent redesigns.
Provide historical comparison only; do not pool old and new outcomes as one evidence set.

correctness_and_compute_exceptions.H12: Keep as corrected core behavior, not a strategy feature requiring re-promotion.
correctness_and_compute_exceptions.H13: Keep as correctness/product-path work; snapshot harness cannot provide meaningful strength evidence for it.
correctness_and_compute_exceptions.H14: Keep 200k as the provisional compute regime; H14 is not an evaluator feature.

stage_1_broad_rescreen.purpose: Give old strategy hypothesis families a fair current-stack screen before constructing a new sequential lineage.
candidate_families: H2 useful outgoing attack / cancellation value
H3 B2B charge / Surge state value
interaction_only_history: H8 useful-attack x row-transition joint tuning
stage_1_broad_rescreen.interaction_policy: H7/H8 are not treated as standalone promoted features. Preserve them as interaction clues and revisit when the relevant base features exist in the new incumbent.

default_screen_design.pairing: Game A: candidate uses seed X, incumbent uses seed Y. Game B: candidate uses seed Y, incumbent uses seed X.
default_screen_design.independence_note: The two games in one asymmetric pair form one paired unit and must not be counted as two independent observations.
default_screen_design.reason: Avoid deterministic mirror locking such as the 5000-lock H1 cap behavior observed in run 35431278966.

stage_1_broad_rescreen.optional_extension: A borderline 8-pair result may be extended to 12 paired units before deciding whether fresh confirmation is worth the compute. Extension must be recorded before inspecting the added outcomes.

screen_status_policy.screened_positive: Current small-sample evidence is promising enough to justify fresh confirmation.
screen_status_policy.screened_neutral: Current small-sample evidence is weak or mixed. Pause; do not infer equivalence or permanent uselessness.
screen_status_policy.screened_negative: Current small-sample evidence is sufficiently negative to stop spending compute for now.
screen_status_policy.confirmed: Fresh confirmation supports adding the feature to the current incumbent.
screen_status_policy.rejected_for_now: Fresh evidence does not support promotion under the current incumbent and stack.
screen_status_policy.retest_if_context_changes: Archived candidate that may be reconsidered when the incumbent, authority, search budget, or a strongly interacting feature changes.

small_sample_rule.principle: Small-sample failure controls current compute allocation, not the permanent truth value of a feature.
never_do: Do not delete or forget screened-neutral or screened-negative candidates.
Do not label a small-sample loss as proof that the feature is universally bad.
Do not promote or reject based on APP when KO points the other way.
retest_triggers: Search budget or search algorithm changes materially.
Authority, garbage timing, or observation boundary changes.
A newly promoted feature has a plausible interaction with the archived candidate.
The prior screen was close or internally mixed.
KO and diagnostics strongly disagree in a way that suggests a mechanism worth revisiting.
small_sample_rule.deep_freeze_guidance: Repeated, strongly negative current-stack results across sensible parameter choices may be assigned very low priority, but the evidence remains preserved rather than deleted.

stage_2_confirmation_and_lineage_growth.entry: Only stage-1 candidates with a credible positive signal proceed immediately.
stage_2_confirmation_and_lineage_growth.confirmation: Use fresh asymmetric paired seeds; choose the confirmation sample size and decision rule before inspecting outcomes.
stage_2_confirmation_and_lineage_growth.promotion: A confirmed candidate becomes part of the new incumbent.
stage_2_confirmation_and_lineage_growth.next_candidate_rule: Every later feature is tested for marginal value against the current incumbent, not forever against corrected legacy.
stage_2_confirmation_and_lineage_growth.re_screen_after_promotion: Previously neutral/negative candidates may be revisited when there is a plausible interaction with the newly changed incumbent.
stage_2_confirmation_and_lineage_growth.reference_check: Periodically compare a mature new incumbent against the frozen review_h9_h12 benchmark and corrected_legacy_h12, without using those reference matches as substitutes for per-feature promotion evidence.

historical_run_handling.whole_profile_transfer_and_confirmation: Retain as evidence that the old tuned package contains useful signal under Tetrp authority, but not as proof that each old component remains beneficial.
historical_run_handling.single_component_ablation_run_3543127896: Retain as partial historical evidence and as the reason to avoid symmetric same-seed evaluation. Do not use the four H1 caps as wins, losses, or draws.

next_action: Design the current-stack broad rescreen workflow from corrected_legacy_h12 using fresh asymmetric paired seeds. Do not continue the old reverse-ablation lineage as the primary strategy-selection path.
